findings.diagnosis: PAY, 'Accept card payments', schedules BANK, integrating an unfamiliar bank API, after UI and COPY. BANK depends on an external team, the integration is unproven and no spike exists. Discovering integration constraints last risks rework and delayed payment delivery after the preceding work is complete.
